messages:
Asha V: Pipeline Inc sent an RFI asking for a capability matrix + security questionnaire. Key asks: 150 TPS embedding throughput for POC, customer-managed HSM in prod, EU data residency, and committed POC pricing. I linked docs.

Tom R: I'll own the matrix. Need a concise row for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private covering KMS/HSM, data residency, burst policy, and retention.

Kelsey H: Ops needs expected avg tokens (120), p95 latency <200ms, and a sample load test plan. I'll draft the POC runbook with k6 script.

Matt B: For 150 TPS embeddings recommend Dedicated (4 GPU baseline) with burst credits. For HSM we can support customer-managed HSM only on Private; Dedicated supports customer KMS but not external HSM appliances.

Legal Bot: Confirmed. We'll prepare a DPA addendum for HSM and data residency clauses. Also note: SOC2 + ISO attachments required.

Asha V: Pricing ask: 8-week POC, ask for a 20% discount on committed monthly rate + 1 week burst credits. Can Commercial confirm?

Tom R: Draft CSV snippet uploaded: https://drive.redwood/pipeline-cap-matrix.csv

Kelsey H: Runbook draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/pipeline-poc-runbook.md (includes monitoring, rollback, and test scripts).

Matt B: Models to list in RFI: rdx-llm-3.2, rdx-embed-2.1, open-gpt-medium (INT8). I'll attach perf numbers.

sales-bot: RFI deadline 48h. Checklist: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, pricing sheet, POC runbook, certifications.

Asha V: Thanks team  consolidate and send to Pipeline by EOD tomorrow. Tom: please finalize matrix and tag Legal on HSM wording.
